title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode6 Avoiding Regret

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: A few weeks later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We just have the final fight scene left to shoot. It's the film's climax, so I need to prepare for it as best I can.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? L-Len?
What are you doing here at this hour?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. Remember that film you said you're making with your class? I came over to see how it's going!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, it's going really well.
Also, Len, you were right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh? About what?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember that wall I talked about and how you said it'd disappear after I got to know everyone better?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Talking to them as we shot our film made everything you said come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're all their own people with their likes and dislikes. I learned about the dreams they have, or that they like taking care of children...all kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After hearing all their stories, that wall startled crumbling away bit by bit, just like you said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, it feels like I'm talking to them like regular classmates...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But there are still some things about them that I don't know how to deal with... For example, the way they get excited so easily.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, I'm really glad you got a chance to know them better!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I can't wait to see what your guys' film looks like once it's all done!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<But how am I gonna actually watch it...?
You only get to screen it at school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry. Once it's all done, I'll bring a copy of the video over to SEKAI. We can watch it together there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really?! Thank goodness.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? A message...?
It's so late. Who's...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Shiraishi, Shinonome...
Where's Soda...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's here.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Hahaha... Sorry, Kusanagi.
I picked a great time to get injured, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, don't say that...!
More importantly, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
It's nothing serious.
Like I said in my message, it's a light sprain.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
But since it's my ankle...
I'm really sorry, but I don't think I can do any more stunts...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Still, I'm relieved...
Thank goodness it's nothing serious.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Yeah... I really am sorry, everyone!
First I can't act, and now I'm out as a stunt double. I feel like such a burden...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's all spilled milk...
Also, it's not like you got hurt on purpose.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What he said! You don't need to worry or apologize since we know you were doing your best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, what are we gonna do...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're shooting the climax really soon. We can't wait around for his sprain to heal because of our reservation for that site and how the film still needs to be edited.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
We'll need to find a replacement.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
But can any of us replace him...?
I mean, they'd have no time to practice... At this rate, the climax is gonna end up being really dull...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
I'm not sure there's anything we can do about that.
Finding someone okay is better than not finishing the film...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: But we've come so far...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's true that filming something of high quality may be difficult now that Soda's out...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is this the way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(We've put in all this work...
If all we're thinking at the end of our shoot is how we had no choice but to cut a few corners and make a dull final product...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This film's gonna make us feel a lot of regret.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And Soda...
He'll probably think it's all his fault.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Just like when...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone put so much effort into that show, but it was all for nothing, because I forgot my lines.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's the worst feeling in the world...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was given a second chance with Tsukasa and the others. I got an opportunity to make things right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this film may be everyone's only chance.)

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
I'm going to do whatever it takes!
Get ready for some really cool fight scenes!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, next take?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...!
Let's see this through until the end and make our film an amazing one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As the director, I don't want this film to end on a sour note...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, everyone...
Can I have your attention for a second?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I don't want this film to cause someone to feel any regret. Not after all the hard work we put into it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want us to all genuinely feel good about what we made together.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, let's put our heads together and make sure we all come out of this with no regrets...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's come up with the best possible solution we can for this situation. A solution that doesn't involve cutting corners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We shouldn't be thinking such negative thoughts. Instead, we should be coming up with ways to make our film better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Exactly.
So, about finding a replacement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll do it. If my stunt double is out, then the simplest solution is for me to do my own stunts...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Soda, you'll need to show me what to do during the final scene. I know we don't have time, but this is our only option.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No problem.
But there's no way I'll be able to do the same things an experienced martial artist like Soda can...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is there a way to mask that?
Something that'll make what I do look flashier...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Flashier...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if you wore a cape or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A cape?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that's not a bad idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Capes are used during shows a lot because they help draw attention to the wearer... In our case, it'd be like throwing in a bit of extra spice at the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The last scene also involves our hero returning from his journey in search of cooking ingredients, so him wearing something over his clothes would seem completely normal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tachibana, would you be able to lend us a hand with this?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem.
I'll ask everyone working on costumes to help me come up with a design right away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
Then, Soda, can you and the others come up with some stunts that involve a cape?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, we can change up our camera angles a bit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Amisawa, remember that drone footage you showed me the other day? The final showdown would probably look really cool if we shot it from a bunch of different angles.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Definitely!
Alright, I'll look up how to do all that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think that's about all I can think of...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep brainstorming and coming up with ideas together. And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The goal's in sight, so let's keep doing our best to make our film a good one.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
